files.content:
from solution import escaped_field_parser as f
assert f('a\\,b,c\\\\d,') == 'a,b|c\\d|'
assert f('x,,y') == 'x||y'
assert f('') == ''
assert f('a\\q') == None
assert f('tail\\') == None
assert f('\\\\,') == '\\|'

prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.py with the function at module scope.
Required API: def escaped_field_parser(input: str) -> str | None
Behavior: Parse comma-separated fields where backslash may escape only comma or backslash. Empty fields are retained. Reject a dangling backslash or any other escape. Return decoded fields joined by |.
Visible example: a\,b,c\\d, returns a,b|c\d|; a\q is invalid.
